sm.$description: Small internal padding for compact non-interactive containers such as small cards, callouts or panels.

md.$description: Default internal padding for standard non-interactive containers such as cards, panels and grouped content blocks.

lg.$description: Large internal padding for more spacious containers, larger cards, feature blocks or modal content areas.

xl.$description: Extra-large internal padding for prominent layout areas, hero panels or spacious feature sections.

xs.$description: Extra-small vertical gap between very closely related stacked items.

sm.$description: Small vertical gap between closely related stacked items, such as label and helper text.

md.$description: Default vertical gap between related stacked elements.

lg.$description: Large vertical gap between grouped components or content blocks.

xl.$description: Extra-large vertical gap between larger content groups.

xs.$description: Extra-small horizontal gap between tightly related inline items.

sm.$description: Small horizontal gap between inline items such as icon and text, chips, tags or compact controls.

md.$description: Default horizontal gap between related inline items such as buttons, navigation items or grouped actions.

lg.$description: Large horizontal gap between inline groups where more separation is needed.

headingToBody.$description: Vertical spacing between a heading and the body text that directly follows it.

bodyToAction.$description: Vertical spacing between body content and a following action area such as buttons or links.

paragraph.$description: Default vertical spacing between paragraphs or prose blocks.

compact.$description: Compact vertical padding for interactive controls. Minimum target size should still be enforced with size.control.minBlockSize.

default.$description: Default vertical padding for interactive controls such as buttons, inputs, selects and tabs.

comfortable.$description: Comfortable vertical padding for larger or more prominent interactive controls.

compact.$description: Compact horizontal padding for interactive controls.

default.$description: Default horizontal padding for interactive controls.

comfortable.$description: Comfortable horizontal padding for larger or more prominent interactive controls.

gap.$description: Default internal gap between elements inside an interactive control, such as icon and label.

base.$description: Base vertical spacing between major page sections.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint vertical spacing between major page sections.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint vertical spacing between major page sections.
